item.title: Women's Basketball Falters Late to Queens
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Women's Basketball team dropped a 70-66 score to Queens University at Charlotte on Saturday afternoon from Allen Arena.

item.title: O'Brien's Start Spoiled by Flyers in Second Game of Baseball's Season Opening Series
item.description: NASHVILLE – Despite six innings of no-hit baseball by Cole O'Brien, the bats went quiet for Lipscomb University, as the Baseball program fell 3-1 to the University of Dayton to force a rubber match in the 2026 opening series, Saturday from Ken Dugan Field at Stephen Lee Marsh Stadium.

item.title: Bisons Bounce Back with Run-Rule Win Over Furman After Day 2 Opener
item.description: GREENVILLE, SC – Lipscomb Softball split Day 2 of the Furman Tournament on Saturday, falling to Towson in the opener before responding with a run-rule victory over host Furman in the second game.

item.title: Women's Tennis Drops Late Decision at ETSU
item.description: JOHNSON CITY, Tenn. – The Lipscomb University Women's Tennis team suffered a late setback to East Tennessee State University by a 4-3 score, Saturday afternoon from the ETSU Mini Dome.

item.title: Men's Basketball Falls at Queens Despite Second Half Surge
Bisons Compete in Split-Squad Weekend at Boston University and Vanderbilt
item.description: NASHVILLE, Tenn. – Lipscomb Track & Field split squads over the weekend of Feb. 13–14, competing at the BU David Hemery Valentine Invitational in Boston, Mass., and the Vanderbilt Music City Challenge in Nashville, Tenn. The Bisons turned in strong performances across both meets, highlighted by a program record, event wins, and solid depth across sprints, distance, and field events.

item.title: Men's Tennis Battles Vanderbilt
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Men's Tennis team dropped a 7-0 decision to Vanderbilt University on Sunday evening from the Lummis Family Tennis Center.

item.title: Putting on the Miles; Eighth Inning Rally Lifts Baseball to Series Win over Dayton
item.description: NASHVILLE – Hutson Miles' eighth inning double was enough for the Lipscomb University Baseball team to take down the University of Dayton to take the rubber-match of the first series of 2026, 9-6, Sunday afternoon into the evening from Ken Dugan Field at Stephen Lee Marsh Stadium.
